getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil.player: Hi there. Looks like you're in some trouble.

getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil.speaker: Lady Servil
getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil.text: The cart? That's the least of my problems. I've got to find my family...
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 50.

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: You'd be willing to?

steps.player: Of course. Tell me what happened.

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: Well, I'm Lady Servil. I was travelling to Ardougne with my husband, Justin, and son, Sammy, when our cart broke on some rocks.

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: Some of General Khazard's men spotted us and offered to help, but they demanded my husband and son fight in their arena first! We said no, but they took them anyway!

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: He's a menace! This entire area is under the control of him and his mercenary group, the Khazard Army. They prey on the weak and vulnerable, making them fight in that arena of theirs, all for entertainment!

steps.player: That's horrible! How are they able to get away with it?

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: The authorities don't care. Khazard's men just pay them off if they ever come to investigate.

steps.player: Well they won't stop me. I'm going to try my best to find your family.

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: Thank you. They'll be somewhere inside the arena. I'll be waiting here for you.

steps.player: Well I hope it works out. Good luck.

getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil-a.speaker: Lady Servil
getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil-a.text: Adventurer, please... bring back my family. They'll be somewhere inside the arena.

getting-started-talking-to-spectator-aft.speaker: Spectator
getting-started-talking-to-spectator-aft.text: Hello, stranger. Are you here for the fight arena?

getting-started-talking-to-spectator-aft.speaker: Spectator
getting-started-talking-to-spectator-aft.text: Inside? Are you sure about that? Only Khazard guards are allowed in there. Unless you know where to get some of their armour, you won't be visiting anyone.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-off-duty-k.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-off-duty-k.text: Well I'm off-duty right now, so why don't you go and bother someone else.

entering-the-arena-searching-the-armour-.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a helmet and platebody. However, you don't have enough room to take them.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.speaker: Lady Servil
entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.text: Have you had any luck with freeing my family?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.player: I've managed to get a guard's uniform, hopefully I can infiltrate the arena.

steps.speaker: Khazard Guard
steps.text: None of your business. Clear off!

steps.speaker: Khazard Guard
steps.text: Someone came in and stole my armour!

steps.player: Oh no! I'll let you know if I see anyone suspicious...

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-door-g.speaker: Door Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-door-g.text: Are you new? I've never seen you around here before.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-door-g.player: You could say that. Long live General Khazard!

steps.speaker: Khazard Guard
steps.text: There should be some good fights today.

steps.speaker: Khazard Guard
steps.text: Keep an eye out for anything suspicious.

steps.speaker: Khazard Guard
steps.text: I think I'll head to the bar on my next break.

steps.speaker: Khazard Guard
steps.text: Don't bother me while I'm on duty.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-spectator-.speaker: Spectator
entering-the-arena-talking-to-spectator-.text: Hello there. I hear the Servil family are fighting soon. Should be very entertaining.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-a-khazard-.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-a-khazard-.text: What are you doing here? Leave at once!

entering-the-arena-opening-door-while-a-.player: This door appears to be locked.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-while-a-.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-opening-door-while-a-.text: Nice observation guard. You could have just asked to be let in like a normal person.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-joe-or-kel.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.player: Do either of you know of the Servil family?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: If we did, why would we tell a guard?

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: Until our last breath, our every action will be against Khazard. Never will we help you.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: I spit on Khazard, and all who do his bidding.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-joe-or-kel.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.player: Do either of you know of the Servil family?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: I've heard of them, but if your hope is to help them, I fear you may be too late.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: You should leave while you can. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-slave.player: Hello there. I'm looking for the Servil family.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-slave.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Slave
steps.text: Please leave me alone.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-slave.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Slave
steps.text: I've never heard of them.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: Hmm... You don't seem like a real guard to me. Who are you?

steps.player: No one important. I'm looking for the Servil family.

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: I've seen them in here, but my advice to you is to leave them. Whatever plan you have will only end with you in a cell as well.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: You're not a guard. What are you doing in here?

steps.player: I'm looking for the Servil family.

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: I've seen them in here, but my advice to you is to leave them. Whatever plan you have will only end with you in a cell as well.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.speaker: Head Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.text: Er... yes... quite right. Did you need something?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.player: Just checking if you have any orders for me.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.speaker: Head Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.text: Not right now. Things are all very boring at the moment. What I'd give to be over at the bar having a nice Khali brew...

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.player: Khali brew? Can't say I've ever had one.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.speaker: Head Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.text: Oh, nothing beats them! Mind you, don't make the mistake of having too many. Last time I did, I ended up falling straight to sleep.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.speaker: Head Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.text: What a boring day. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.player: Not long now until you get a break though, right?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.speaker: Head Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.text: Too right! Then it's straight to the bar for a nice Khali brew.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.speaker: Head Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-the-head-g.text: This area is restricted. Leave now!

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.player: Don't worry, I'm here to help. Where do they keep the keys?

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.speaker: Sammy Servil
getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.text: The Head Guard has them. He's the one with the big sword.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.player: Don't lose heart, I'll be back.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-again.speaker: Sammy Servil
getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-again.text: Hello. Do you have the keys?

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-again.speaker: Sammy Servil
getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-again.text: Please hurry. The Head Guard has them. He's the one with the big sword.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-lady-servil-.player: Lady Servil, I have managed to infiltrate General Khazard's arena.

steps.speaker: Joe/Kelvin
steps.text: Get away! One day we'll have our revenge on you all!

steps.speaker: Joe/Kelvin
steps.text: Spare us your fake pity. I spit on Khazard, and all who do his bidding.

steps.speaker: Joe/Kelvin
steps.text: You're not safe here, traveller. Leave while you still can.

steps.speaker: Joe/Kelvin
steps.text: You're brave coming in here. If the guards get you, you'll be the next one in a cell.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-a-slave.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Slave
steps.text: Please leave me alone.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-a-slave.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Slave
steps.text: Why am I here?

steps.speaker: Slave
steps.text: Please leave me alone.

steps.speaker: Slave
steps.text: What did I do to deserve this?

steps.speaker: Slave
steps.text: You're not safe here. Leave while you can.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-hengrad.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: Hmm... You don't seem like a real guard to me. Who are you?

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: If you say so.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-hengrad.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: You're not a guard. What are you doing in here?

steps.speaker: Hengrad
steps.text: If you say so.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-khazard-barm.speaker: Khazard barman
getting-the-keys-talking-to-khazard-barm.text: Hi, what can I get you? We have a range of quality brews.

options.text: I'd like a Khali brew please.

steps.player: I'd like a Khali brew please.

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: That'll be five gold coins please.
If the player doesn't have 5 coins:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have enough room for one.

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: There you go, that's five gold coins. I suggest lying down before you drink it. That way you have less distance to collapse.
The barman gives you a Khali brew in exchange for five coins.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: What a boring day. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.player: Do you still fancy a drink?

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: Oh... okay then, but just the one.
You hand a bottle of Khali brew to the Head Guard and he quickly drinks it all.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: That is some gooood stuff... yeah... wooh, yeah!

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: Yeesshh! Oooh, maybe I sshould relax for a while.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.player: Good idea. I'll look after the prisoners.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: Yeesh... that shounds reasonable. Here, take the keysch. Any trouble, you give... you give 'em a good beating.
The Head Guard gives you some keys.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.player: Don't worry, I'll keep them in line

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: Pleash... leave me alone. Did the walls always shway soooo much?

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.player: Hi, er... I lost the keys.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: What? You're foolish... and I'm all drunk. Here... takes my shpare shh... set!
The Head Guard gives you some keys.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.speaker: Head Guard
getting-the-keys-talking-to-the-head-gua.text: Thish areash resh... restricted! We don't like strangersh... 'specially ones who sway. Oooh!

getting-the-keys-using-keys-on-a-cell-th.player: The gate is locked, but Sammy's not in there anyway.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.player: Sammy look, I have the keys.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.speaker: Sammy Servil
getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.text: Wow! Please hurry and set me free.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.player: We'll need to wait for the guards to change shift, but don't worry, you'll be out soon...

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.text: The player unlocks Sammy's cell and Sammy steps out.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.player: Now, let's get you out of here.

getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.speaker: Sammy Servil
getting-the-keys-talking-to-sammy-servil.text: Not yet! We need to find my dad!
The player follows Sammy into the Fight Arena.
The Khazard Ogre's cage is unlocked, and it attacks Jimmy Servil.

the-battles-trying-to-exit-the-arena-thr.prompt: Are you sure you want to leave?

the-battles-talking-to-a-spectator.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Spectator
steps.text: Hello there. I hear Khazard's got some great fights lined up today. I can't wait!

the-battles-talking-to-a-spectator.text: If the player doesn't have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Spectator
steps.text: Hello, stranger. I hear Khazard's got some great fights lined up today. I can't wait!

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.player: Lady Servil, I freed your son, but he went to help your husband.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: No! Please, you have to help them!

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: Well, well, well, you seem to be in quite the rush. Do you have somewhere else to be?

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: You presume correct. I must say, I sense a great air of defiance to you. Does my appearance not fill you with fear?

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: How arrogant. No matter though, you will come to learn.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: Now, despite your entertaining show, the two individuals you are attempting to leave with are my property.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: Ha! Well if their freedom is so valuable to you, how about a trade? Fight in my arena, and if you win, I'll let them go.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.player: And what if I refuse your offer?

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: Well... I wasn't actually giving you a choice. Guards, take [him/her/them] to the cells.
The player is taken to a jail cell.

the-battles-talking-to-a-spectator-after.speaker: Spectator
the-battles-talking-to-a-spectator-after.text: Hey, you're the one from the arena! That was some great fighting!

the-battles-talking-to-a-spectator-after.speaker: Door Guard
the-battles-talking-to-a-spectator-after.text: So you're back for more are you? General Khazard will be pleased.
The player is taken back to the jail.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: Hello there. So Khazard got his hands on you too?

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: Well if you're lucky, you might last as long as me.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.player: How long have you been here?

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: As long as I can remember. I was a child when his men kidnapped me. My whole life has been spent killing and fighting, all in the hope that one day I might escape.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: Wait... sounds like the guard is coming. Looks like you'll be going back into the arena. Good luck, friend.
The player is brought into the arena.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: Now watch closely, friends. I fear this may be where your protector dies.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: Ignore him! You can do it!

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: I don't know how you managed to escape, but you may not be as lucky next time. Get out of here while you can.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-scorpion.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-scorpion.text: Impressive, but now for a proper challenge. Time for my puppy. Bring on Bouncer!

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: You monster! You'll pay for what you've done!

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.player: I only did what you asked. I fought in your arena. Now let the Servils go.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: Fine! I am not a coward who makes false promises. I have no need of them anyway. You on the other hand, won't be going anywhere.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: Guard, escort the Servils out. I'll take great pleasure in dealing with this one myself!

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: Don't try to fight him! Just run!

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer-opening.speaker: Khazard Guard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer-opening.text: You! You're the one who killed Bouncer.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer-talking.speaker: Spectator
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer-talking.text: Hey, you're the one who beat Bouncer! Amazing!

the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.text: Ha! Arrogant fool! You think you can kill me? I am General Khazard! My power is absolute!

the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.text: Now, part of me would very much like to kill you for what you've done today, but let it be known that I am not without generosity.

the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.text: You proved yourself in battle against me. That is something few can boast of. For that, you may leave. However, if you ever oppose me again, I won't hesitate to wipe you from existence!

the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-defeating-general-khaza.text: Now go. I have business to attend to elsewhere that is far more important than you.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: You're alive! I feared General Khazard would have killed you!

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: Thank goodness. I'd have never forgiven myself if you'd have died saving my family.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: Now, you'll be pleased to know that my son and husband are safe and recovering at home. Without you they would certainly be dead. Thank you, for everything.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: Please, take this payment. It's the least you deserve.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: You're alive! I feared General Khazard would have killed you!

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.player: He tried, but I was able to defeat him.
I thought I had at first, but it seems he is not that easy to kill.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: Now, you'll be pleased to know that my son and husband are safe and recovering at home. Without you they would certainly be dead. Thank you, for everything.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: Please, take this payment. It's the least you deserve.
